title: Den Fears/Quotes
summary:
"This Seeker stuff is hard work!"
- Den Fears to Dante Vale (The Casterwill Connection)

"You know, it's still hard to believe that I'm a Seeker, not a regular kid any more."
- Den Fears to Lok Lambert, (The Titan in the Temple of Sun)

"Nothing but trees and boulders in sight. Where's a guy gonna get a sandwich around here?"
- Den Fears to Dante Vale (Sophie on Trial)

"Uh, guys? I think we made the magical floating castle mad."
- Den Fears to the team, (Back Home)
